summary: Iteration 146 — Wrap Command Center Phase 2D both-side testing. BACKEND 25/25 PASS (test_iteration146_wrap_phase2d.py, 30.9s). FRONTEND 100% of review_request flows verified PASS. BACKEND COVERAGE: GET /api/wrap/items/{id} now returns top-level `production` and `install` blocks (legacy docs auto-backfill via _serialize → production has all 10 PRODUCTION_CHECKLIST_KEYS:false + matching `_at`:null + production_status='not_started'/assigned_to=''/production_notes=''/tasks=[]; install has 14 schedule fields + checklist={each of 10 INSTALL_CHECKLIST_KEYS:false} + issues=[]) plus pipeline_state extended with production_complete/install_active/install_complete. PUT /production subset persists (production_status/assigned_to/printed/files_ready) and stamps `printed_at` + `files_ready_at`; production_notes from earlier PUT preserved (exclude_unset). Production checklist idempotency verified: true→true preserves existing `_at`, false clears to null, true→false→true generates a new ts. Invalid production_status returns 400. POST /production/tasks/load-defaults appends exactly 10 tasks named [Review approved proof, Prepare print files, Check dimensions/panels, Print wrap panels, Laminate wrap panels, Outgas if required, Trim panels, Label panels, Pull install materials/tools, Stage for install] only when tasks=[]; 2nd call is no-op (still 10). POST /production/tasks creates a task with status='not_started'/completed_at=null. PUT /production/tasks/{id} status='complete' sets completed_at; switching back to 'in_progress' clears completed_at to null; invalid status returns 400. DELETE /production/tasks/{id} removes it. PUT /install subset (install_status/install_date/install_start_time/installer_name/hours_estimated/install_location/bay_needed) persists; install_notes from previous PUT preserved. customer_signoff=true sets customer_signoff_at; idempotent (true→true preserves ts); false clears ts to null. Final-signoff auto-flip verified strictly: install_status='complete' ALONE does NOT flip approvals.final_signoff_completed (stays false); customer_signoff=true ALONE does not flip; BUT install_status='complete' AND customer_signoff=true together → approvals.final_signoff_completed=true with timestamp. PUT /install checklist={one_key:true} merges (other keys preserved); unknown checklist keys return 400; invalid install_status returns 400. POST /install/issues with issue_type='Misprint' adds an issue with resolved=false/resolved_at=null/created_at=ISO. PUT /install/issues/{id} resolved=true sets resolved_at; idempotent on re-set; resolved=false clears to null. DELETE removes it. Invalid issue_type returns 400. Pipeline derivation verified: production_status='complete' → ps.production_complete=true; install_status='scheduled' → ps.install_active=true, ps.install_complete=false; install_status='complete' → ps.install_complete=true; production_status='ready_for_install' also counts as ps.production_complete=true. Non-wrap guard returns 400 'not a wrap' on all 9 new endpoints (PUT /production, POST/PUT/DELETE /production/tasks, POST /production/tasks/load-defaults, PUT /install, POST/PUT/DELETE /install/issues). No mongo _id leakage (recursive check on GET + PUT responses). Phase 2A/2B/2C regression smoke: GET returns vehicle_info/wrapped_areas/materials/pricing/design/contract/approvals; POST /recalculate returns pricing_snapshot. FRONTEND: Logged in as thesigntistslab@gmail.com on viewport 1920x1100. /orders/118b7377-.../items/aa0387f8-.../wrap-command-center loads with 15 pipeline chips (prefix wrap-status-chip-{slug}). PRODUCTION TAB (wrap-tab-production): renders prod-select-status, prod-input-assigned_to, prod-input-notes, prod-save-btn; editing fires prod-unsaved-indicator and clears after Save (toast 'Production saved'). 10/10 prod-toggle-{key} render. Clicking prod-toggle-printed fires PUT immediately; prod-ts-printed appears/disappears with state (verified by toggling pre-existing ON state to OFF then back ON). Production tasks: after reset 10 default tasks loaded (prod-task-row-*), prod-load-defaults-btn correctly hides once tasks exist, prod-add-task-btn opens prod-task-add-form. INSTALL TAB (wrap-tab-install): all 15 schedule controls render (install-select-status, install-input-date/start/end/installer/helper/location, install-toggle-bay_needed, install-input-dropoff/pickup/est_hours/actual_hours/notes/completion_notes, install-save-btn). Editing installer fires install-unsaved-indicator; saving shows 'Install saved' toast and clears indicator. 10/10 install-checklist-toggle-{key} render. install-toggle-customer_signoff present. install-add-issue-btn opens install-issue-add-form with issue_type/area/description/photo_placeholder fields. After autoflip test the pipeline chip 'install' rendered with bg-emerald-50 (install_status='complete' on backend). REGRESSIONS: wrap-tab-vehicle/measurements/pricing/design/contract all click and load without errors. Non-wrap item /items/e19d6501-.../wrap-command-center silently redirects to /orders/118b7377-... (verified). AI helper testids prod-ai-helper + prod-ai-helper-action-0..4 present (still placeholder/toast-only per spec).
critical_code_review_comments: wrap.py _empty_production / _empty_install / _serialize correctly backfill missing blocks AND missing keys inside checklist for legacy wrap_data documents — no migration script needed. Verified by GET on the pre-seeded ticket.
PUT /production reuses the timestamp-idempotency pattern (key:true with existing ts preserves it; false clears ts to null) for all 10 PRODUCTION_CHECKLIST_KEYS — same shape as _set_approval. Clean.
Final-signoff auto-flip is correctly conjunctive (install_status='complete' AND customer_signoff=true). Single-condition cases never flip — verified explicitly with three sequential PUTs.
load-defaults is correctly no-op when tasks already exist — guards against duplicate seeding from a double-click in the UI.

wrap.py is now ~1590 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting into routes/wrap/{production,install,design,contract,pricing,measurements}.py before Phase 3. Reading & maintaining is getting unwieldy.
Issue invalid issue_type is correctly checked against ISSUE_TYPES (12 values) returning 400 with allowed list. Good.
Install checklist partial merge correctly preserves untouched keys — confirmed by sequential PUTs of {surface_cleaned:true} then {vehicle_received:true}.
No mongo _id leakage anywhere — including nested production/install/tasks/issues/pipeline_state. _serialize strips recursively.

Minor: ProductionUpdate exposes the 10 checklist booleans as siblings of production_status; works fine but a nested `checklist` map (like install) would be more symmetric and easier to add new keys to without touching the model.
Minor: InstallUpdate exposes 14 fields with installer_name + helper_name + install_location etc; consider grouping schedule vs notes vs metrics in sub-models if more fields are added later.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration146_wrap_phase2d.py (new — 25 tests, includes 9 parametrized non-wrap guard cases)
seed_data_creation: Used pre-seeded wrap ticket aa0387f8-... — tests use a _reset_state helper to put production_status='not_started', install_status='not_scheduled', customer_signoff=false, final_signoff_completed=false at the start of order-sensitive cases. After the run the ticket is left in: production_status='ready_for_install' (re-set near the end of pipeline test), install_status='complete', customer_signoff=true (autoflip test), approvals.final_signoff_completed=true, tasks=10 defaults + 1 added/deleted (net 10), one issue created/deleted (net 0). Main agent can reset via PUT /production {production_status:'not_started'}, PUT /install {install_status:'not_scheduled', customer_signoff:false}, PUT /approvals {final_signoff_completed:false} if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2D is fully wired and verified. wrap_data Mongo doc now stores `production` (status + assigned_to + production_notes + 10 checklist bools w/ matching _at fields + tasks[]) and `install` (14 schedule fields + customer_signoff/customer_signoff_at + checklist:{10 bools} + issues[]). pipeline_state derives production_complete (in {complete, ready_for_install}), install_active (in {scheduled, vehicle_received, in_progress, installed, customer_picked_up}), install_complete (=='complete'). Auto-flip rule: backend route calls _set_approval('final_signoff_completed', True) only when install_status=='complete' AND customer_signoff is True (conjunctive). The 12 ISSUE_TYPES are: Misprint, Wrong size panel, Color issue, Bad file, Installer mistake, Vehicle issue, Paint failure, Adhesion issue, Weather issue, Customer delay, Material defect, Other. Field name is install.install_notes (NOT installer_notes — got me in 1st pass). Frontend status chips data-testid prefix is wrap-status-chip-{slug}; emerald = complete, violet = active first non-complete, slate = upcoming. All AI helper buttons (prod-ai-helper-action-*, install-ai-helper-action-*) remain placeholder/toast-only per spec — do NOT call backend.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Phase 2D matches every spec bullet exactly: production status + 10-checklist idempotency, default-tasks seeding, task CRUD with completed_at flip rules, install schedule subset, customer_signoff idempotency, conjunctive final-signoff auto-flip, install checklist partial-merge, install issue log CRUD with resolved_at idempotency, pipeline_state extension, non-wrap guard on all 9 new endpoints, _id stripping, Phase 2A/2B/2C regression clean.
